title: agent-config-baseline control
description: A single control record. Control content is versioned by release; this schema is versioned by schema_version.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never renumbered, never reused after retirement.

status.description: draft: may change incompatibly. active: stable. deprecated: retained for reference, not evaluated.

deprecated_by.description: Replacement control ID when status is deprecated.

profiles.description: Profiles this control belongs to. Only strict-general exists today; the array keeps the schema stable if profiles are added.

applies_to.description: Artifact types the control evaluates. Skills, instruction files and MCP server declarations are defined by open specifications; extension packages and agent settings (project-scope agent-settings, organization-scope managed-settings) have no open specification, so they are located only through client data and are never defined by one product.

check_type.description: static: decidable from file contents alone. provenance: needs release/attestation metadata. behavioural: needs evaluation runs.

severity.description: Maps to SARIF level: high=error, medium=warning, low=note. In strict-general every control must pass regardless of severity.

audit.description: Ordered audit procedures. Each must be implementable without calling a model.

method.description: structure: parse and check fields. pattern: match text indicators. inventory: enumerate files and compare.

indicators.description: Illustrative, non-exhaustive examples of failing content. The checker owns the actual detection logic.

exceptions.description: Whether a documented, reviewed exception may waive this control for a specific artifact. Inline suppression is never permitted.

owasp_asi.description: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 IDs.

five_eyes_risk_areas.description: Risk areas from Careful Adoption of Agentic AI Services (ASD's ACSC, CISA, NSA, Canadian Centre for Cyber Security, NCSC-NZ, NCSC-UK; May 2026).

nist_csf.description: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 (NIST CSWP 29) subcategory IDs.
